545:t_027:10.en:
$$カスパー$$
「Hurry up and answer. $$レナード$$ is impatient for your reply.」

545:t_027:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That guy...! Could he be $$ヴィルヘルム・カスパー$$?!」

545:t_027:13.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I heard about him from the previous $$ロックオン$$... He's a sniper whose skill goes beyond master level. You could call him a demon.」

545:t_027:14.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Even $$ロックオン$$ said that much about him...」

545:t_027:15.en:
$$クルツ$$
「And he was my mentor, too...」

545:t_027:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「'Course I am. I'm the second most immortal guy after $$キリコ$$.」

545:t_027:18.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That bastard $$カスパー$$ stepping out in the flesh is going to be the death of him. I'll blow him away from right here.」

545:t_027:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't worry. My M9's scrap now, it's no good to anyone...」

545:t_027:21.en:
$$クルツ$$
「My weapon's a Winchester M70... I don't plan to leave so much as a scratch on $$テッサ$$.」

545:t_027:22.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's not what I mean...! Your position...!」

545:t_027:23.en:
$$クルツ$$
「The distance to him... is about 1,650 meters...」

545:t_027:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Even a demon like $$カスパー$$ probably tops out at 1,500 meters for a shot.」

545:t_027:26.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But if $c surrenders to $$アマルガム$$ to save $$テッサ$$, a lousy ending is all that's waiting for us.」

545:t_027:27.en:
$$クルツ$$
「If we dawdle, knowing $$テッサ$$... she might think she's a burden, panic, and jump down from up there...」

545:t_027:28.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So that's how it is... Bet on my skill here.」

545:t_028:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Remember this, $$ミシェル$$. A sniper's absolute condition is never missing when it counts.」

545:t_028:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well then... time to do it. Keep pretending you're torn, so he doesn't move.」

545:t_028:6.en:
$$カスパー$$
「I don't care to be stalled forever. You have five more seconds to answer.」

545:t_028:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
(...Damn. My head's starting to spin...)

545:t_028:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Sousuke... Make sure you save $$カナメ$$...)

545:t_028:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
($$テッサ$$... I'll save you no matter what, so give up on that gloomy guy quick and find yourself a good man.)

545:t_028:13.en:
$$クルツ$$
($$メリッサ$$, who's really such a lonely girl... I wanted to spoil you more.)

545:t_028:14.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Would even a woman like you cry...? I wonder...)

545:t_028:15.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Part of me wants you to cry, part of me doesn't... Maybe I shouldn't have slept with you after all...)

545:t_028:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
(And $$カスパー$$... I may be a flunking student to you, but I have no intention of becoming someone like you...)

545:t_028:18.en:
$$クルツ$$
(You really were the best sniper... But you were the kind who didn't give a damn about harm to bystanders if it meant bringing down your target...)

545:t_028:19.en:
$$クルツ$$
(If that's your idea of a true sniper, I don't want to become a monster like that.)

545:t_028:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
(And I won't let a monster like that do as it pleases with my comrades' lives.)

545:t_028:22.en:
$$クルツ$$
(I'm not giving up just because he's 1,650 meters away...)

545:t_028:23.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Wind, turbulence, temperature, humidity, tumbling, the Coriolis force...)

545:t_028:24.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Keep every factor in mind, then clear it all. I'll draw the bullet's path by instinct.)

545:t_028:26.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm betting everything I have...! It's showtime!」

545:t_029:1.en:
$$カスパー$$
「There's... no way... it could... reach...」

545:t_030:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You did it, $$クルツ$$! Dead on target!」

545:t_030:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「A real shot... that I staked my life on...」

545:t_030:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You idiot, $$クルツ$$! After all that refusing, you pull the short straw at the very last moment?!」

545:t_030:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Looks like it, unfortunately... I'll have... a marksmanship contest... with the previous $$ロックオン$$... in the afterlife...」

545:t_030:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Look after Sousuke for me, $n. You two get along... and stop being the quiet type...」

545:t_030:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Sorry... Sousuke... Looks like I can't... back you up anymore...」

545:t_031:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「We've confirmed $$アマルガム$$ and the Empire's forces! They seem to be targeting each other!」

545:t_031:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...In our current depleted state, staying here means annihilation.」

545:t_031:2.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant. We have no choice but to give up on recovering $$ウルズ$$ 6.」

545:t_100:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$始原の特異点$$. Your existence gave me a major hint for my plan as well.」

545:t_100:1.en:
$$桂$$
「So without knowing it, I ended up aiding a villain's scheme.」

545:t_100:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Not that it's a thank-you, but I'll eliminate you with my own hands.」

545:t_100:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Originally, it was your existence that warped the entire world!」
